title: Must Care be chosen when health is recorded?
detail: Record health defaults Care to "No action needed", so the quickest path (choose Fever, Save) records a fever that needs no attention. Care is the only editable condition state and decides whether a condition is an alert. This is a product rule on what is recorded, not a picker detail, so it is left as it is.
options: No default: Care is required and Save waits for it
Default by condition (a disease defaults to Monitor)
recommendation: Owner to rule. If Care becomes required, it joins Conditions in the Required marking on a waiting Save.

title: Short outcome lists open a picker sheet where the record-sheet law asks for an inline Choice
detail: Care (4 outcomes), Outcome on Resolve (2), Body condition (2) and Dose unit (3: mL, mg, g) each open a single-choice sheet. The record-sheet law says 2 to 4 outcomes are a Choice (radio rows or inline), and a fifth makes it a picker; on iOS and Android these are a segmented control or radio rows, not a sheet. Left as approved in this pass.
options: Inline radio rows for Care, Outcome and Body condition; a segmented control for Dose unit
recommendation: Inline Choice, as the law says; it removes a drawer hop for a gloved hand.
